description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init).

First hand-written design: 3 layers, no LayerNorm. L1 prev-token heads + MLP (4th-digit flag, 3-letter month lookup); L2 earliest-flag anchor heads (first digit, first '/', 4-digit-run end, first '_', month id); L3 parabola pointer readers (anchor+offset) + gated one-hot MLP chooses the source per output step.
v1 with layer-3 d_ff trimmed from 240 to the 150 units actually used.
Logits written onto the (unused) input one-hot slice instead of a separate OUT slice.
Ablation: remove the EARLY (position<3) gate on the 4th-digit flag; false flags near the start break half of the examples.
Pointer-parabola sharpness C_PEAK=6.
Pointer-parabola sharpness C_PEAK=3 (still perfect at this stage).
Previous-token features restricted to letters+digits (36 dims instead of 43).
Softer anchor attention: B_FLAG=100, C_EARLY=2.
Name-format flag derived from month-id anchor (layer-2 MLP) instead of a separate letter-existence head.
Merged 2-digit-year reader into the year reader: year anchor falls back to the first '_' (minus 1).
Dropped unused residual slices (A_L, ISLET, RYY).
Year anchor = 3rd digit of a run (drops the p-3 head) but forgot to move the EARLY gate: YYYY.MM.DD and YY cases break.
EARLY gate moved to p<2; still wrong when the answer's own 3-digit run (positions 32-34) is mistaken for the year.
Also gate the 3-digit flag off in the answer region (p>=31): fixes it.
Same model; debug validation on 2000 extra examples: 0 failures.
